tooltips.apiKey: Account-level API token from Chat. Automatically populated when a concierge user is created. Required for contact synchronization. Can be manually set from: Chat → Profile Settings → Access Token.
tooltips.conciergeUser: The chat user entity representing the concierge user for this account. Used for API operations.
tooltips.tenant: Tenant that owns this account. Auto-resolved from the account's team when its team is the tenant's base team. Set explicitly to override.
tooltips.conversationBackfillPage: Set when a WhatsApp history import delivers older chats: the next Chatwoot page the conversation sync reads to bring every conversation into the CRM. Empty when nothing is pending.

messages.selectedUserMustHaveEmail: Selected CRM User must have an email address.
messages.selectedUserMustBelongToAccountTeam: Selected CRM User must belong to the same team as the Chat Account.
messages.chatwootUserAlreadyAssignedToAnotherUser: This chat user is already assigned to a different CRM user.
messages.noAccountAccess: You do not have access to this Chat Account.
messages.noUserAccess: You do not have access to the selected CRM User.
